claim_boundary: decomposition and sensitivity of the frozen issue-79 rollouts only; no re-freeze, amendment, or reinterpretation of the issue-79 published dispositions; both families (NovPhy / CLEVRER) stay reported separately; no new physics family, no planning/ranking estimand, no perception claim, no leaderboard/VQA claim; descriptive intervals only; either localization answer (concentrated or uniform) is a valid outcome

compute.note: candidate counts do not exist on CLEVRER (no planning estimand); units, transition steps, wall and active parameters are reported per arm; inference is not equalized; per-cell wall seconds are equal shares of the measured group wall

definitions.arm_pair_note: arm hybrid executes the hybrid checkpoint through its continuous-abstraction pair (issue-79 hybrid_continuous systems); the micro symbolic-execution pair is out of scope

arms.continuous: ContinuousDynamics at the frozen issue-79 width 456, continuous-abstraction pair

estimands.E1: segment-conditional recursive error growth curves: mean masked position_mse and masked velocity_mse per visited relative frame restricted to cells whose scored frame carries the segment label, per h in {1,5,15}, per arm, per seed, plus the mean over seeds; unit counts reported per point
estimands.E2: localization contrast: post_settlement vs pre/active (union) mean masked position_mse at each scored endpoint; the statistic is the ratio post/pre_active of mean-over-seeds per-unit errors, with a paired bootstrap interval over the joint unit roster (10000 draws, rng 7201); reported for grid endpoints {15,30,60,90,120} and window relative endpoints {15,30,60}
estimands.E3: sensitivity tables: recursive position_mse curves over the finer endpoint grid {15,30,60,90,120} and over the issue-79 anchor points {15,30,60,120}, each under the frozen inside_camera_view mask and the all_frames variant, per arm and horizon, with the strict-increase monotonicity predicate across consecutive endpoints
estimands.anchor_note: anchor-grid, frozen-mask, continuous-arm curves recomputed here form a new descriptive consistency table against the published issue-79 numbers; the #79 verdict itself is never recomputed or amended
estimands.dropped: no new training, no planning/ranking estimand, no perception claim; the micro symbolic-execution pair is not an estimand here (issue-79 Q2 covers it)

definitions.rollout: recursive fixed-pair rollout from the true carrier at the window start / eval context; one shared initial carrier per cell, predictions feed the next transition, no truth resets; per-visited-frame errors against the true carrier at the scored frame

limitations: decomposition of the frozen issue-79 rollouts; no re-freeze or amendment of any issue-79 verdict
engine-annotation features in, no visual perception on either arm; shared frozen parser contract
descriptive paired bootstrap over (scene, start-or-context) units; no inferential claim
the hybrid arm runs its continuous-abstraction pair; the micro pair stays with issue-79 Q2
segment labels derive from collision-event timelines, not from measured object speeds

representation.all_frames_variant: no visibility mask: mean squared error over the declared objects' position/velocity columns against raw annotation values in carrier units, fixed denominator declared_objects x 2 per frame
representation.availability_mask: inside_camera_view in columns 7 and 10; unavailable fields zeroed; all masked estimands
representation.masked_variant: frozen inside_camera_view mask, identical to issue-79 field_errors

segmentation.census_note: strata sizes are outcome-free data facts published at freeze; the frozen precision minimum is 8 units per stratum
segmentation.rule: frame-level labels from each scene's frozen collision timeline, frozen before any error is computed: pre_first_collision before the scene's first collision event; active_cascade from the first through the last event (objects in transit between contact events remain inside the active cascade); post_settlement after the scene's last event. Window and context boundaries only select which frames are scored; labels depend on scene timelines alone.

source.note: frozen checkpoints are re-loaded, never retrained; #79 verdicts are never recomputed or amended
source.rollout_records: 1296 published issue-79 eval cells, 0 typed failures (read-only inputs)
